summary: Iter 91e — Stock Mix warehouse/stores split + custom date range. Both backend and frontend fully verified. 11/11 pytest passed; UI shows new columns, custom range refetches, formula caption + span render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend invariant code (server.py L3673-3690) correctly splits inventory by is_warehouse_location() so warehouse + stores always equals stock_units; verified live: 74,890 = 28,162 + 46,728.
Custom-range swap logic at server.py L3615-3616 silently swaps date_from > date_to — verified via test.
Single-side date fallback works (only date_from or only date_to ⇒ falls back to window_days preset).

Frontend (ExecutiveSummary.jsx L1372-1429) CSV exporter places Warehouse Units, Warehouse %, Stores Units, Stores % at column positions 6-9 of every category, subcategory, and the Total row — exactly as RC described.
Subtitle '(28,162u warehouse · 46,728u stores)' renders correctly via L1440.
Clear-X button (data-testid=exec-stockmix-custom-clear) is conditionally rendered only when a custom range is active — visible in screenshot after dates are filled. This is the expected design.
seed_data_creation: None — read-only tests against live data.
